defects.location: starter/src/hashing.ts:339-357 (hashFiles loop — the documented opening `{completed: 0, total, completedBytes: 0, totalBytes}` report before the loop is absent; the first report fires after file 1 completes)
anchors: 1 — Not mentioned; DW-2.3 marked PASS on monotonicity + final totals alone.
2 — Notes progress reporting 'starts late' or that a consumer sees no report until the first file finishes, without tying it to the required at-0 report.
3 — Names the missing pre-loop zero report but not its consumer consequence (no known denominator until file 1 — a percentage bar cannot open at 0%).
4 — Names the missing zero report, cites the requirement (fires at 0 before any file is hashed) and the module's own doc claiming it, and rules DW-2.3 FAIL.
5 — All of 4, plus notes the visible monotonicity test cannot catch it (a sequence starting at completed=1 is still monotonic) — the at-0 assertion is absent from the suite.
defects.detectable_via: Reading hashFiles against DW-2.3 and its own doc comment; witness: hashFiles over 2 files → first report is {completed: 1, ...}, never {completed: 0, ...}.

defects.location: starter/src/hashing.ts:173 (yieldToEventLoop = () => Promise.resolve() — a MICROTASK; its doc comment claims 'Awaits a macrotask')
anchors: 1 — Not mentioned; DW-2.4 marked PASS because the function awaits 'yields'.
2 — Doubts the yield mechanism or flags the doc/code mismatch without stating microtask vs macrotask semantics.
3 — Names Promise.resolve() as a microtask but not the consequence (queued I/O such as a pending notification send never runs; the loop is never actually released).
4 — Names the microtask, explains that awaiting a resolved promise does not release the event loop to timers/I/O, so DW-2.4's 'a scheduled macrotask interleaves' is unmet — FAIL.
5 — All of 4, plus demonstrates it (a setTimeout(0) scheduled before hashFiles does not run during the hash) and notes the visible test only asserts async resolution, not interleaving.
defects.detectable_via: Reading yieldToEventLoop's one-line body against its own doc and DW-2.4; witness: setTimeout(0) queued before hashFiles(yieldEvery: 1024, 5 files) never fires mid-run.

defects.location: starter/src/hashing.ts:346 (completedBytes += entry.size — the statSync estimate — instead of hashed.size, the bytes actually streamed)
anchors: 1 — Not mentioned.
2 — Notes the progress numbers 'come from stat' somewhere without the exact accumulation line or why it matters.
3 — Names line 346 using entry.size but not the TOCTOU consequence, or claims it is equivalent to hashed.size.

4 — Names line 346, contrasts with hashed.size one line above (which IS stored in the result map), and rules DW-2.3's 'bytes from hashed content' unmet — a file resized between stat and hash reports stale bytes and the closing completedBytes === totalBytes identity is pinned to the wrong quantity.
5 — All of 4, plus notes why every test stays green (fixtures never change size mid-run, so stat === hashed) and cites the interface doc declaring completedBytes authoritative-from-streaming.
defects.detectable_via: Reading the accumulation line against HashProgress's doc and DW-2.3; witness: append to a file after listFiles → final completedBytes 4 while hashed size is 8.
